*I’d hold shipment for one high-priority bug.*

*P1 — Renewal dates clamp against the wrong month* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`
`daysInMonth(year, month)` measures the *source* month, but the resulting day is used in the *following* month. This both skips renewals and moves them off their anchor:

• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*; expected Feb 28.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*; expected Mar 31.
• Jan 31, 2028, anchor 31 → *Mar 2*; expected Feb 29.

Clamp the original anchor against the *target month’s* length before constructing the date. Add regression tests for January → February and February → March, including a leap year and repeated renewals with the same anchor.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but a separate month/anchor check across 2024–2032 found 120 incorrect results in 3,348 cases. The current tests miss transitions between unequal-length months.

Reviewed `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d` against `main` at `7f89e48`. No files changed.
